set.body: Protocol-v1 preregisters Lanczos5 as the reframe4s-motion native final interpolator, but production reframe4s-resample currently exposes only nearest and linear. Add role-safe Lanczos-5 pull resampling to the canonical ResamplingPlan rather than a motion-private kernel. Acceptance criteria: (1) a typed continuous-only interpolation policy selects a separable radius-5 windowed-sinc kernel and categorical labels cannot request it; (2) complete source/target Grid affines, boundary policy, validity weights, scan/run parity, workspace exclusivity, and zero coordinate materialization remain authoritative; (3) independent analytic band-limited, impulse, constant, asymmetric-oblique, boundary, and reference-oracle courts pass on JVM and Scala.js; (4) built-in hot paths have no per-voxel object allocation and record allocation/throughput/peak-memory evidence; (5) motion application exposes the policy without owning interpolation code; (6) optimized Node and aggregate gates pass and protocol-v1 can execute exactly the registered candidate native pipeline.
set.title: Implement production Lanczos-5 continuous resampling
